verdict.rationale: Docs show capabilities directly relevant to debugging workflows: agentic codebase search to understand structure and narrow root causes (docs-15), live web app debugging via Chrome (docs-17), sandboxed autonomous command/test execution (docs-50), and explicit claims that Claude 'verifies it works' after making changes (docs-2/28), plus CI-based issue triage (docs-36). However, there is no explicit documented workflow for 'reproducing' a bug end-to-end, and community reports show mixed real-world reliability with debugging tasks (e.g. a subtle replace_all bug in comm-8, complaints about inconsistent quality in comm-9/comm-12/comm-13), tempering confidence without outright contradicting the core capability. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of a reproduce→isolate→verify debugging loop, and stronger independent benchmarks confirming debugging accuracy at scale.
